newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: MGX makes two acquisitions for 22 mln rand.
newsitem.headline: MGX makes two acquisitions for 22 mln rand.

text.p: Information technology company MGX Holdings Ltd said on Monday it had acquired 32.4 percent of ExSol Solution Systems (Pty) Ltd and the business of The Paper Bank Marketing Co (Pty) Ltd for 22 million rand.
The acquisitions, effective retrospectively from March 1, will be settled by a combination of cash and shares.
On a fully diluted basis, the two new companies were expected to contribute to MGX's targeted earnings growth of 40 percent for the year to June 30, 1998, the company added.
